# Compromise title

Template: record only a real accepted compromise. For genuinely unknown historical dates use unknown with source provenance.

## Compromise

What is temporary or imperfect in the actual implementation.

## Why it exists

Why it is consciously tolerated now.

## Allowed while

Measurable or clearly verifiable conditions under which it remains acceptable.

## Remove when

State whether all listed conditions or any one condition is sufficient. List actual verifiable conditions; removal tasks must inherit them by reference.

## Risk

What could fail and the practical impact.

## Guardrails

Link actual tests, monitoring or operating restrictions that contain the risk.

## Exit

The concrete removal path and verification. Set resolved only after the compromise has actually been removed and checked.
